Can be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

hologram.name: [Hologram] Ignore Defense Enhancement
hologram.desc:
Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.

Can be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

programs.name: Modular Heart
programs.effect: Reduces Damage Taken by 3/6/9/12%
programs.flavour: A secondary heart module that can be equipped in the Battlesim. Dissipates damage taken.

programs.name: Overclock Core
programs.effect:
Increases Final Damage by 8/10/12%
Increases Damage Taken by 5/10/15%
programs.flavour: A core that increases combat output beyond your calculated limits at the cost of your defensive capabilities.

programs.name: Synchronization Chip
programs.effect: Increases Final Damage by 4% per current sector (up to 10 sectors).
programs.flavour: The deeper you go, the higher your synchronization with the simulation. Searching for signal...

programs.name: Quality Assurance
programs.effect:
Increases Final Damage by 3% for every 10 sec you are not hit by an attack. Stacks up to 5 times.
Resets when hit.
programs.flavour: A training program that highlights flaws in your combat technique, but resets if you take damage.

programs.name: Data Compression
programs.effect: Increases EXP Obtained by 10/20/30/40%
programs.flavour: A data management program that compresses and archives combat data for easy reference.

programs.name: Backspace
programs.effect: 10/20/30% chance for skill cooldowns to reset immediately
programs.flavour: An incredibly powerful tool that can revert any mistake...except that it only works occasionally.

programs.name: Energy Drink
programs.effect: Upon entering a floor, increases Attack Power & Magic ATT by 100% for 10 sec.
programs.flavour: The preferred beverage of those who need to supercharge their energy levels! WARNING: Should not be consumed by children, people who are pregnant, people over 30, people with bad stomachs, people who are sensitive to caffeine, people--

programs.name: Emergency Backup
programs.effect:
If HP falls below 30%, instantly recovers 20/30/70% of max HP
Cooldown: 120 sec
programs.flavour: An emergency restoration program that rolls your body back to a previous version where it isn't about to be immediately destroyed. WARNING: Back Up Point Unknown.

programs.name: Inspector's Stamp
programs.effect: Increases Bytes Obtained 30/50/100%
programs.flavour: The official stamp of an Inspector of Quanah, which entitles the bearer to greater reimbursements.

programs.name: Nest egg
programs.effect: Increases Final Damage by 3% for every 70 Bytes owned (up to 20 times).
programs.flavour: A mountain of wealth would never come back to Byte you...right?

programs.name: Buffer Overflow
programs.effect: Earn 20/30/50 Bytes each time you obtain a different program.
programs.flavour: A mysterious program that disperses Bytes each time you download a new program. Best not to ask where the funds come from, though.

programs.name: Wild Pointer
programs.effect:
Immediately obtain 50 Bytes upon pick up.
Once owned, it will not appear again.
programs.flavour: A misplaced digital archive. Bereft of its owner, but not of its owner's funds.

programs.name: Dependency Injection
programs.effect:
Upon entering a floor, spend 50 Bytes to obtain one of the following:
- Item Drop Rate +40%, EXP Obtained +10%
- EXP Obtained +40%, Item Drop Rate +10%
Does not activate if you lack sufficient Bytes.
programs.flavour: A dart that gives you good luck if thrown with Bytes on the line. There's only one way to see where it lands.

programs.name: Memory Leak
programs.effect:
Increases Final Damage by 1% for every program owned (up to 20 times).
Decreases 3% of max HP every 10 sec
programs.flavour: How many programs can you run before something goes wrong? Only one way to find out!

programs.name: Hard Reset
programs.effect:
Upon obtaining, deletes 10 installed programs that you have at the time of obtaining at random
Increases Final Damage by 5% for each program deleted. (Re-activates upon obtaining it again.)
programs.flavour: Reverts everything to factory default. Just make sure to consider what you'd lose.

before.effect:
Upon obtaining, deletes all installed programs that you have at the time of obtaining
Increases Final Damage by 5% for each program deleted. (Re-activates upon obtaining it again.)

programs.name: Simulation W
programs.effect: When attacking an enemy with a Hologram skill, a projected warrior uses [Hologram] Worldreaver and activates [Hologram] Format. The [Hologram] Format from the projection can also activate [Hologram] Defrag.
programs.flavour: A holographic program that models and projects a hardlight warrior.

programs.effect: When attacking an enemy with a Hologram skill, a projected magician uses [Hologram] Bolt Barrage and activates [Hologram] Format. The [Hologram] Format from the projection can also activate [Hologram] Defrag.
programs.flavour: A holographic program that models and projects a hardlight magician.

programs.flavour: A holographic program that models and projects a hardlight Bowman.

programs.name: Simulation T
programs.effect: When attacking an enemy with a Hologram skill, a projected thief uses [Hologram] Shurrikane and activates [Hologram] Format. The [Hologram] Format from the projection can also activate [Hologram] Defrag.
programs.flavour: A holographic program that models and projects a hardlight thief.

programs.name: Simulation P
programs.effect: When attacking an enemy with a Hologram skill, a projected pirate uses [Hologram] Rolling Rainbow and activates [Hologram] Format. The [Hologram] Format from the projection can also activate [Hologram] Defrag.
programs.flavour: A holographic program that models and projects a hardlight pirate.

programs.name: VPN
programs.effect: [Hologram] Registry reattach time decreased by 1/2/3 sec
programs.flavour: Retransmits electronic signals through alternative routes. Useful for clandestine access.

programs.name: Simulation Enhancement: W
programs.effect: Projected Warrior [Hologram] Worldreaver Damage Increased by 10/20/30%
programs.flavour: A hack that removes the force limiter placed on the projected warrior. WARNING: You are operating with NO safeguards!

programs.name: Simulation Enhancement: M
programs.effect: Projected Magician [Hologram] Bolt Barrage Damage Increased by 10/20/30%
programs.flavour: A hack that removes the force limiter placed on the projected magician. WARNING: You are operating with NO safeguards!

programs.name: Simulation Enhancement: B
programs.effect: Projected Bowman [Hologram] Ultimate Snipe Damage Increased by 10/20/30%
programs.flavour: A hack that removes the force limiter placed on the projected bowman. WARNING: You are operating with NO safeguards!

programs.name: Simulation Enhancement: T
programs.effect: Projected Thief [Hologram] Shurrikane Damage Increased by 10/20/30%
programs.flavour: A hack that removes the force limiter placed on the projected thief. WARNING: You are operating with NO safeguards!

programs.name: Simulation Enhancement: P
programs.effect: Projected Pirate [Hologram] Rolling Rainbow Damage Increased by 10/20/30%

programs.name: Strangler Fig Pattern
programs.effect: Upon defeating monsters, recovers 5% of HP with a 10/20/30% chance
programs.flavour: If a toy is an effective weapon...is it really a toy?

before.effect: Upon defeating monsters, recovers 5% of HP with a 20/40/60% chance

programs.name: Entropy
programs.effect:
Increases Final Damage by 50%
Upon entering a floor, 30% chance to stack [Disorder] once
Upon stacking [Disorder] 3 times, you will exit the dungeon automatically
programs.flavour: All systems tend naturally towards disorder. This program merely hastens the process.

programs.name: Black Box
programs.effect: Immediately upon obtaining, you will receive 3 random programs, and have 2 of your owned programs removed at random. (Re-activates upon obtaining it again.)
programs.flavour: A nigh-indestructible data archive. What's inside? There's one way to find out...but it might cost you.

programs.name: Overheated Head
programs.effect:
Upon entering a floor, obtain 10 Bytes
20% chance to remove 1 owned program (including yourself!)
programs.flavour: A computing device that performs endless calculations...even if sometimes it loses data through overheating.

programs.name: Creaking Limb
programs.effect: Attack Power & Magic ATT: +20, Speed: -20
programs.flavour: Waiting for repair... Repair Schedule: Unknown. Waiting for repair... Repair Schedule: Unknown. Waiting for repair...

programs.name: Broken Heart
programs.effect:
Increases exclusive potion recovery by 30%
Damage taken increased by 10%
programs.flavour: A heart that's been shattered and welded back together time and again. And yet, somehow it keeps on beating.

programs.name: Overclocked Fusion
programs.effect:
Decreases Damage taken by 30%, increases Final Damage by 30%
Obtain 300 Bytes upon pick up
programs.flavour: The result of three unstable programs melding into one. Once fused, they cannot be separated again.

programs.name: Empty Bottle
programs.effect: Exclusive Potion Recovery: +90%
programs.flavour: A bog-standard empty bottle. It can be filled with anything! WARNING: Empty bottles should only be filled with things that can fit in empty bottles.

programs.name: Debuggy
programs.effect:
Upon death, you are revived at 100% HP
Debuggy disappears after it has been activated.
programs.flavour: A helpful program that catches and devours bugs. It can even use all of its power to consume errors! Debuggy disappears when full.
programs.note: Invincible for 2 sec after it activates.

programs.name: Rubber Duck
programs.effect: It has no effect whatsoever.
programs.flavour: After extensive analysis...this seems to be a Rubber Duck.

programs.name: Return Protocol
programs.effect:
When used, allows you to immediately bypass the Break Map and exit the dungeon.
All rewards can be claimed. Disappears after use.
programs.flavour: A safety protocol that calls an immediate end to training. Consider it a...'strategic retreat.'

programs.name: Dummy Mapae
programs.effect:
Enemies hit are stunned for 5 sec
Can by applied to 15 enemies, including bosses
Is consumed upon use.
programs.flavour: Once activated, you have approximately 5 seconds until the enemy realizes that it's plastic.

programs.name: Garbage Collection
programs.effect:
Invincible for 10 sec
Is consumed upon use.
programs.flavour: Recycling data... Please standby.

programs.name: Desynced Timer
programs.effect:
Resets cooldown of 5th Job skills and below.
Consumes 1 each time it's used.
programs.flavour: A timer whose measurements are always a little off. Fortunately, it's always in your favor.

programs.name: Bug: Clogged Fan
programs.effect: Final Damage: -5%
programs.flavour:
Error - Error - Error
Attack Data Contaminated - Cause: Fuzzball.
No matter how hard you hit it, it only lets out a small puff.

programs.name: Bug: Deadlock
programs.effect: Speed: -20
programs.flavour:
Error - Error - Error

Why don't they fit???

Some geese lay golden eggs. Others just eat your Bytes!

encounters.title: Mystery Trader
encounters.text:
A man appears as you are operating the console. It isn't clear if he's real or a hologram. He grabs the program screen.
'What do you say to a little trade? I'll even give you a good deal. One of your programs for two of mine.'
He opens a trade request window. Somehow,, he's hidden the names of the programs--both his and yours.
'No one can see the future. You'll know what you get if you agree,' he says.

encounters.title: Blood Altar
encounters.text:
The altar is old and worn, but has a clear indent in the shape of a hand.
Text is engraved in the surface: 'You stand before the BLOOD ALTAR. (Note: the Blood Altar is in compliance with all workplace safety regulations, and collects your HP in accordance with the advice of a healthcare professional.)'
There are ominous bloodstains all around the altar, but when you place your hand in the indent, you just feel a faint tingling, like an electrical signal.
choices: Press your palm fully on the indent.
Take your hand away and step back.

encounters.title: Fortune Teller
encounters.text:
The fortune teller clears the table, leaving one single card.
'I can see in your future... A boss fight. Ah, I can tell you'd like to hear more, but I'm afraid that's against the rules. I can offer you a charm that will prove useful, at least.'
She lays out the charm, but as you reach to grab it, a Byte payment window pops up over it. Of course.
choices: Pay the bytes for the charm.

encounters.title: Campfire
encounters.text:
A campfire burns in an empty camp. The simulated warmth on your skin feels almost like the real thing.
It's obvious that this is intended as a place to rest. You start to settle down when you see something among the left-behind belongings...
choices: Sit by the fire to warm up.

encounters.title: Pickpocket
encounters.text:
Someone bumps into your side as you pass with an angry, 'Watch where you're going!'
You start to protest when you notice that your pocket feels lighter... The culprit has already made it a ways away, and starts to run as you look back.
The thief vaults a low wall, and you see lots of debris lined up conveniently in your path. The simulation doesn't seem to be on your side.
choices: Vault the obstacles and give chase.
Check your byte balance and leave.

encounters.title: Vending Machine
encounters.text:
All sorts of tempting equipment, items, and Bytes spill out of the open case of the vending machine. It's only after watching a pile of Bytes fall at the exact same location three times that you realize it's nothing more than a looping video.
Just then, a message pops up on the screen. 'Win fabulous prizes and real EXP!'
Just below that, in a notably smaller font, is a second message: 'Bytes spent are nonrefundable.'
choices: Test your luck with a few bytes.

encounters.title: Tester
encounters.text:
Beyond a gap in the grid, you see a person. When you walk over to her, she stops tapping on her holographic screen and looks at you, eyes wide. 'Hey! How'd you get in here? Did I forget to close the wall again...?'
You sneak a glance at her screen and see a long list of programs and a button that says 'Activate All'. Noticing your gaze, she smiles.
'It's for testing, of course. What, I'm supposed to start from nothing every single time?' After a moment of hesitation, she points it at you. 'Wanna give it a try? Just this once. And don't tell anyone where you saw me.'
choices: Pretend you didn't see anything and leave.

encounters.title: Abandoned Console
encounters.text:
A console is protruding awkwardly from one of the walls of the simulation. It seems like someone was downloading data and forgot to come back.
You can't help but think about how much easier this training would be if you had some of that data...

encounters.title: Bug
encounters.text: Bugs can sneak in anywhere and at any time.

encounters.title: Wellspring of Oblivion
encounters.text:
A wellspring of oblivion has arisen from a gap in the implementation. It's as clear as glass, but no matter how hard you peer into it, you can't see an end...
In Quanah, as elsewhere, the fresh start of forgetting can be a blessing... But it can also be a curse. While there are many things you may wish to wash away, you may find yourself repeating the past.
choices: See your face reflected in the spring

encounters.title: The Call
encounters.text:
Through the gaps in the grid, just visible through the twisting recesses of dimensions, something calls out to you, as if promising to free you from this false world. All you have to do is answer...

Will you accept the call?

You can withdraw all rewards you have earned so far, and claim them in the UI's Dungeon Inventory.

Upon exiting, all programs and currency you've obtained will disappear.
